# supervisetest

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/supervise/supervisetest"
```

Package supervisetest gives service tests a root group with automatic cleanup. NewRoot registers a test cleanup that requests shutdown and waits for all children. Tests can use the returned group with supervise.Start and StartGroup.

## func NewRoot

```go
func NewRoot(t testing.TB) *supervise.Group
```

NewRoot reports supervised failures and their stacks with t.Errorf and registers cleanup with t. The first failure requests Stop before it can select a terminal root failure. Cleanup waits up to 5 seconds for the group to stop, then reports a test failure if work remains. Reports after cleanup are ignored. Run methods must observe cancellation. Use a subprocess with supervise.NewRoot to test a terminal root panic.
